title: Pricing extension point, version 1
description: Extension point price: what a partner's sandboxed pricing module reads on every sale (input, price/1) and what it answers (answer). The module runs inside the shop — on the server at the preview and the booking, on the till offline, and again at the drain — after every promotion, and may only take money off a line. The answer is judged whole by business_logic/partner_price.py validate_answer (the till's twin: mpos_partner_price.js validatePriceAnswer): one bad entry refuses the whole answer and the engine's own price stands. Page: docs/extending/price.md.

input.description: price/1, canonical JSON (sorted keys, no spaces, raw UTF-8): money in the currency's own minor units, quantity in thousandths, no negative number. One module line is every row of ONE cart line at ONE price, luid "<cart line>@<price>". line_total_minor − promotion_discount_minor is the line's current amount, after every promotion and every earlier cut.

config.description: The subscription's own settings object — the partner's configuration, set by the shop.

answer.description: A JSON array: at most one entry per line the module was shown, the money it takes off that line. A line not named keeps its price. Beyond the schema, judged against the input and the shop's limit: each luid must be one the module was shown, discount_minor no more than the line's current amount and no more than the subscription's max_discount_percent of it.
